statement: A corporation formed outside New York that does business in New York State qualifies by filing an Application for Authority with the Department of State under Business Corporation Law § 1304, with a $225 filing fee, accompanied by a certificate of existence (or equivalent) from the home jurisdiction dated within one year; a corporation that did business in New York before filing also needs the consent of the New York State Tax Commission (BCL § 1304(a)(8)).
caveat: What counts as 'doing business' requiring authority is a BCL § 1301 analysis this rule does not resolve. The application designates the Secretary of State as agent for service of process; a separate registered agent is optional. Expedited handling is extra. Verify fees against the live schedule before filing.
